Subject: Internal: Orchid co-term / ramp pricing options

Camila / Marissa — summarized options for the call with Claire: see attached MAA_checklist and my notes. Two recommended paths:

1) 24-month co-term with staged commit (Q1: 30% of committed capacity, Q2: +35%, Q3: +35%). Upfront: 6% prepay credit to lower unit price. Quarterly true-ups with cap (no more than +25% variance allowed per quarter without pricing tier bump).

2) 36-month fixed-term with lower base rate and automatic annual re-slice linked to usage bands; includes automatic burst pool for first 90 days (convertible to committed capacity if used more than 50%).

Tradeoffs: option 1 minimizes financial exposure for Orchid in year 1 and keeps our ARR acceleration predictable; option 2 gives them long-term unit economics but needs exec approval because it pulls forward revenue recognition.

Ask: Marissa, can we approve option 2 disclaimers for enterprise finance? If not, we'll put option 2 as 'exec pending' and lead with option 1.

-Karthik

Subject: Proposed approach: 24mo co-term with staged ramp (details + next steps)

Claire / Procurement — following internal alignment, here's the recommended approach that balances your ramp needs and Orchid's exposure:

Summary (proposal):
- Term: 24 months co-terminating on 12/31/2029 (aligns with your FY).
- Staged ramp: Q1 (Jan-Mar 2029) 30% committed baseline, Q2 +35% (applied as committed increase starting Apr 1), Q3 +35% (Jul 1).
- Billing: quarterly invoicing with a 6% upfront credit applied to year-1 invoices. Quarterly true-ups with a +/- 25% corridor; above that, an automatic tier reprice or purchase of burst credits.
- De-risk: 90-day burst buffer (pre-purchased credits), milestone-based onboarding credits tied to activation dates, and dedicated onboarding SLA for first 90 days.
- Cancellation/exit: standard 60-day notice at renewal; no early-exit credit on consumed burst pool.

Next steps:
1) Procurement reviews Draft_Amendment_v2.docx and replies with any non-standard procurement language.
2) We can run the amendment through DocuSign once procurement confirms; I pasted a link below.
3) Technical kickoff scheduled within 2 weeks of signature; Jonas will lead onboarding.

If that works, I can prepare a short exec summary for your CFO showing the amortized cash impact.

Thanks,
